findings.issue: Wording reverses the politeness relation: 様 does not 'turn into' a formal さん — さま is the honorific upgrade of さん. As written a beginner may conclude さん is the more formal of the two.
findings.current: é o 様 respeitoso que vira さん formal (お客様, 'caro cliente')
findings.suggested: é o さま respeitoso, a versão formal de さん (お客様, 'caro cliente')

findings.issue: Wrong furigana: 大問題 is read だいもんだい, never おおもんだい. The reading attribute on the first としたら example is incorrect.
findings.current: <jp reading="これがほんとうだとしたら、おおもんだいだ">これが本当だとしたら、大問題だ</jp>
findings.suggested: <jp reading="これがほんとうだとしたら、だいもんだいだ">これが本当だとしたら、大問題だ</jp>
